arguments.command:
cd /workspace && timeout 60 python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys, random, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
import ref, gen
rng = random.Random(1)
core = list(range(1,9))
paths = []
for _ in range(20):
    seq = rng.sample(core, rng.randint(3,6))
    path = (rng.choice([100,101,102]),) + tuple(seq) + (rng.choice([100,101,102]),)
    paths.append((path, 1))
agg = ref.aggregate(paths, set())
_l,_r,final = ref.peel_naive(agg)
print('final paths', len(final))
cl = sorted({ref.canon(p[j],p[j+1]) for p in final for j in range(len(p)-1)})
print('core links', len(cl))
t=time.time(); o = gen.find_order(cl, final, rng, tries=50); print('order time', time.time()-t, o)
t=time.time(); occ = ref.occurrences(final, cl); print('occ time', time.time()-t, [len(x) for x in occ])
t=time.time(); Z, marg = ref.brute(occ); print('brute time', time.time()-t, Z)
EOF
